course.title: Engineering Construction Management
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: :The demand for an item in a company is 20000 units per year and the company can produce the item at a rate 5000 per month. The cost of one setup is Tk. 500.00 and the holding cost of 1 unit per month is 50 paisa. The shortage cost of one unit is Tk. 25.00 per month. Determine the optimum manufacturing quantity and the number of shortage. Also, determine the manufacturing time and the time between set-ups.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
